messages:
maya: Quick sync — ran a quant bring-up for cassiopeia-11b (int6) yesterday across our usual GTN slices. Summary: short/FAQ tasks hold up, long-form recall drops ~3.2 pts (ROUGE-L), latency p95 improves 38%, unit cost down ~62%. Sharing raw slices and a quick econ sketch. 

jordan: Can you paste the per-slice deltas vs opt13b baseline? interested in long-form summarization and multi-turn chat.

maya: short answer — best to see numbers. paste below:
```
slice	p95_ms	cost_per_1k	rougeL_delta
short	120	$0.012	+0.4
faq	95	$0.012	+0.1
multi-turn	180	$0.012	-0.8
longform	420	$0.012	-3.2
```
opt13b baseline: p95 680ms, cost_per_1k $0.043, longform rougeL baseline for same slice = (higher by 3.2pts)

priya: From product POV: short and FAQ are safe; longforms are concerning. Could we do hybrid routing (int6 for <=512 tokens, fallback to opt13b for >512)? That should preserve UX for longform.

sam: Also need to check KV cache hit-rate impact after quantization — did you run primed multi-turn with cache enabled?

maya: yes — KV hit-rate ~0.92 on multi-turn tests, no spike in tail latency. Batching at 8 was used for throughput sims. Throughput numbers: int6 pool = 1200 reqs/s (small tokens), opt13b pool = 320 reqs/s.

jordan: Proposed routing rule: if token_count > 512 OR expected_recallscore>0.6, route to opt13b. That keeps cost floor while protecting quality.

priya: Quick unit econ calc for product (approx):
- int6 cost: $0.012 / 1k tokens
- opt13b cost: $0.043 / 1k tokens
- if 20% of traffic routed to opt13b (longform), blended cost = 0.8*$0.012 + 0.2*$0.043 = $0.0176 => ~+47% vs all-int6 but -60% vs all-opt13b
We should show this to GTN as options: (1) aggressive int6 default + hybrid fallback, (2) strict opt13b for heavy recall customers.

ops-bot: canary: schedule hybrid routing flag rollout to 10% of traffic on monday @ 09:00 UTC :rocket:

maya: I'll write a short scorecard for GTN: include the table, unit econ, routing rule, and suggested monitoring (ROUGE-L drift, request-length histogram, latency p95). Next steps: run 5k-slice priming sweep and a 24h canary.

sam: +1. add a quick perf smoke with cold KV cache to make sure tail doesn't regress.

jordan: thanks — looks actionable. I'll pair with maya on the GTN note.
